$Comment: The per-kit mapping import_kit.py reads: which vanilla cave-node graph a kit's pieces come from, which prefab pools it
imports, how its pools are named, tagged and given roles, and how its door classes are named.
Graph: folders under CaveRoot whose .node.json files are the kit's graph. Pools: prefab-name prefixes to import (a pool
outside them is skipped, and so is every join to it). PieceRoot: the prefix cut from a pool to make the piece name in
Zc_Kit_<Kit>_<Piece>. Tags: the engine's own Tags map (key to values) on every room, Kit naming the kit; TagRules add
values by pool prefix (Section: a level or part of the kit), and a Cap takes, key by key, every value of the rooms
whose doors it can close. The engine reads a map as each key, each value and each Key=Value, so a plan filters with
Kit=Stone or Section=Tomb. Roles: the pool's folder path, matched on
its longest dotted suffix. Kinds: a door class (the doors vanilla's graph joins, closed under joining) takes the Kind
of the first rule naming a pool one of its doors sits on; a class no rule names takes Default. ClipDepth: how far
(in blocks) a room's blocks may stand proud of a doorway's wall and be left out of its Box, so the doorway sits on
the Box's face; a room whose doorway stays inside its Box is not imported (PD1's box test could never join it).
Fill: the block written as every room's Fill. Vanilla pastes these pieces into solid rock, and the painter fills the
cells a piece leaves unlisted inside its Box with it. Rock_Stone for both kits: the most common solid block across
the Cursed Crypt's pieces (about twice the next), the most common block facing the Stone kit's carved air (just
ahead of Rock_Quartzite), and the natural rock of the zone vanilla digs both into.
Not imported: Cursed.Transition_Cursed.Stairs. Its West and South doors sit inside its own Box (the stair's
upper body stands over them), so no neighbour or cap could meet them. It was vanilla's only join between the
Cursed section (Kind Cursed_Crypt) and the Tomb section (Kind Cursed_Crypt_Tomb), so a script-built adapter
room (PD7) must make that join: a door of each Kind.
Cursed_Crypt.Label: the Cursed Crypt
